author: Top Gear
description:
Plenty of Porsche 911s have been reimagined by Singer, but ​its latest offering – the DLS Turbo – might well be its masterpiece. For the 99 clients who’ll commission Singer’s DLS Turbo services, the restoration will include a 710bhp twin-turbo flat-six that revs to 9k, but even that’s overshadowed by the outrageous carbonfibre bodywork, inspired by the rare 934/5 endurance racer from the late 1970s. In this world-exclusive review, we drive it on the road and on the race track, but can a Porsche 911 reimagined through Singer’s DLS Turbo services possibly live up to its near-$3m price tag?

🚗 Porsche 911 Reimagined by Singer – DLS Turbo
🎤 Ollie Marriage
